name: Smart Living Allen Genoa
loanTerms: 5-yr fixed at 5.71% with a 2% rate buydown, 2-year I/O then 30-year amortization
note: Kevin's 21 Sep original marketed 20.9% IRR / 2.3x / $158 PSF / $188K exit / 7.1% YoC / Feb close. Kirsh's 2 Oct restatement (20.3% / 2.25x / 9.9% CoC, $11.65M equity, 5-yr full-term I/O at 6.69%) is the set all 83 firms reached before 27 Oct were shown, including the RJL-carveout sends to Cohen & Steers and Corebridge on the morning of 27 Oct. Kevin re-underwrote on 26 Oct: the debt moved from full-term I/O at 6.69% to a 5.71% fixed coupon with a 2% buydown and only two years of I/O, which lifts the IRR but drops stabilized cash-on-cash once amortization starts — exactly the metric Eastham passed on. The figures here are that re-underwrite and are the canonical set for direct LP outreach: they went out on the 634-recipient GMass blast and to CIM on 27 Oct. Kevin's 27 Oct 13:41 send to Ackman-Ziff shows $11.98M equity and 20.9% / 2.28x / 9.2% CoC / 7.0% YoC instead; Zamir confirmed on 28 Oct that the $210K difference is the equity broker fee grossed into the raise, so that set belongs to brokered channels only and is NOT what a direct LP should be shown. PSA TIMELINE, from the fully executed contract (Allied Title order 2026-37449-CM): effective 21 Oct 2026, $250,000 EMD due 28 Oct and confirmed received by escrow that afternoon along with the executed Joinder - REFUNDABLE through due diligence, so the money does not go hard until DD expires on 20 Nov 2026 (refundability per Zamir; the PSA text has not been read here, though Allied Title set the four dates out in writing on 21 and again on 29 Oct), due diligence expires 20 Nov 2026, and the contractual closing date is 21 DECEMBER 2026 — not the January 2027 close every piece of marketing states, including the flyer, the three-pager and all three number sets. That is a one-month gap between the contract and what 368 prospective LPs are being told. Seller carries an $800K non-SPE guaranty in place of an escrow. The close field below is left as marketed; reconciling it is Zamir's call. The date that actually constrains the raise is therefore 20 Nov, when the EMD goes hard, not the closing date: 23 days from today to have equity lined up well enough to let $250,000 go non-refundable.
